ClimateHydrology





Overview of raw climate data collected from all 79 catchments using NVE’s Grided Time Series (GTS). Values are extracted as the mean across each catchment area at a daily resolution, and then further aggregated to monthly mean (or sum in the case of precip).







Overview of raw hydrological data collected from the catchment polygons from the NVE gridded time series. gwb_q = ‘Avrenning’ and gwb_sssrel = ‘vannmetning i jord’. Is Avrenning = discharge (check unit?).
